amos-ct-iso1p5.title: Abdominal organs (CT, AMOS2022), 1.5 mm
amos-ct-iso1p5.description: SlimFormer++ with window self-attention in encoder 1 on 1.5 mm isotropic voxels (patch 128^3, level-0 kernel 3x3x3, first stride 2x2x2), fine-tuned for 100 epochs from the 2.0 x 0.68 x 0.68 mm AMOS2022 CT model. 15 abdominal organs. Mean Dice 89.28 on the 100 AMOS2022 validation CT scans without test-time augmentation.
